<observations>
Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Kitchen remodel total budget: $28,500.
* ✅ (13:30) Agent compiled countertop price comparison quotes.
* 🔴 (16:00) User added a pull-out trash bin to lower cabinets.
* ✅ (19:35) Revised quote package emailed to user.

Date: May 16, 2026
* 🔴 (07:20) User added under-cabinet LED strips (BrightGlow Supplies) and upgraded range hood to a 900 CFM model ($2,750 from VentMaster Inc.).
* 🔴 (16:00) Backsplash tile updated to "Sea Glass".
* ✅ (16:15) Quartz windowsill mock-up PDF sent to user.

Date: May 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected matte black AquaFlow faucet (PlumbPro Distributors).
* 🔴 (09:30) Demolition postponed until flooring arrives; crew arrival set for 08:00–09:00.
* ✅ (11:15) Quartz countertops ordered from StoneEdge Fabricators (ETA June 5).
* ✅ (13:20) Permit checklist updated in shared folder.

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) Backsplash dimensions: 12.5 sq ft.
* 🔴 (08:35) User selected "Honey Oak Classic" engineered flooring (FloorCraft, 250 sq ft, ETA June 12).
* 🔴 (10:40) Upper cabinet paint selected: "Soft Sand" (Pantone 13-0915, ColorHue).
* ✅ (12:20) HOA approved remodel permit.

Date: May 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) Kitchen ceiling height: 9 ft 2 in.
* 🔴 (09:05) Island edge selected: "Cascade Ridge" waterfall edge (18 sq m quartzite from TopStone Granite, ETA July 15).
* 🟡 (10:15) Demolition rescheduled to June 20 with foreman Luis Ortega.
* 🟡 (12:40) Ordered two 36-in sliding glass panels from VistaGlide (ETA June 30) for pantry door conversion.
* ✅ (13:15) Electrical permit amendment approved; lighting plan updated with four recessed LEDs.
* 🔴 (18:45) Sink model confirmed: "AquaPure 24".

Date: May 30, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Island countertop length confirmed: 9 ft 4 in.
* 🟡 (10:30) Ordered 12 sq m "Midnight Slate" quartzite from RiverStone (ETA August 5).
* 🟡 (11:10) EcoFlow Plumbing scheduled to install sink on July 18.
* 🟡 (12:50) Ordered 4 ft x 6 ft frosted glass panel for pantry from ClearView Glassworks (ETA July 12).
* ✅ (13:30) Revised electrical layout received from Miller & Co. (added two GFCI outlets).
* 🟡 (14:15) Lighting updated with "LumenAura" pendant chandelier.
* 🔴 (17:30) Cabinet delivery scheduled for July 2, 2026.
* 🔴 (18:20) User added built-in wine cooler model "Vintner 24" to be installed beside the refrigerator.
</observations>

<current-task>
Primary: Managing the kitchen remodel project schedule, tracking material delivery ETAs (cabinets on July 2, quartzite on July 15, sink installation July 18), and coordinating recent additions like the "Vintner 24" wine cooler.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've noted the cabinet delivery date for July 2 and the addition of the Vintner 24 wine cooler beside the refrigerator. Would you like me to update the master project schedule to reflect these latest additions and upcoming July milestones?"
</suggested-response>
